library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
scoring.system=data.frame(Score=c('x', 999, -999, -998, -997), Type=paste('C', 1:5), Description = c('Number (x) available', 'To be interpreted','Does not apply', 'Cant answer', 'Garbled'))

kableExtra::kable(scoring.system)%>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>%

```{r data , echo=FALSE,message = FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
rm(list = ls())
## load data
scriptPath <- rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path
scriptDir <- dirname(scriptPath)
resp=readxl::read_excel(file.path(scriptDir, '..', 'data', 'values.xlsx'), 
    sheet = "responses")
quest=readxl::read_excel(file.path(scriptDir, '..', 'data', 'values.xlsx'), 
    sheet = "questions")
evts=readxl::read_excel(file.path(scriptDir, '..', 'data', 'values.xlsx'), 
    sheet = "events")
coding= read_csv("C:/github/extreme_weather_risk/data/read_only/coding_report.csv")
names(coding)[5]='id_sub'
styles= read_csv("C:/github/extreme_weather_risk/data/styles_desc.csv")

## groupings
u.resp=unique(resp$id_I)

## formats
head_resp='##'
head_quest='###'
```



```{r, include=T, echo=FALSE, fig.width = 1,results = 'asis', fig.pos='H', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#knitr::include_graphics(file.path(main.dir,x.folder,j.images), dpi = 300)
#for(i in 1:1){
for(i in 1:length(u.resp)){
  cat(sprintf('%s %s\n\n', head_resp, paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i])))
  ##
  i.style=styles[styles$id_I==u.resp[i],]
  i.resp=resp[resp$id_I==u.resp[i],]
  i.code=coding[coding$id_I==u.resp[i],]
  u.quest=unique(i.resp$id_q)  
  u.quest=u.quest[!is.na(u.quest)]
  cat(paste(i.style$text,'\n\n'))
  
  for(j in 2:length(u.quest)){
    
    j.quest=quest[quest$id_q==u.quest[j],] 
    cat(sprintf('%s %s\n\n', head_quest, paste('Q', u.quest[j], '-', j.quest$short_description ))) 
    cat(paste(j.quest$description, '\n\n'))
    cat(paste(j.quest$LIKERT, '\n\n'))
    ## make it a readable table
    j.resp=i.resp[i.resp$id_q==u.quest[j],]
    j.coding=i.code[i.code$id_q==u.quest[j],]
    
    # answer by events
    if(nrow(j.resp)>4){
       if(j.resp[nrow(j.resp),]$id_sub=='extra'){
         cat(paste(j.resp[nrow(j.resp),]$text, '\n\n'))
         j.resp=j.resp[1:(nrow(j.resp)-1),]
       }
    check.multi=apply(j.coding[,1:3], 2, function(x)unique(is.na(x)))
    if(length(unique(as.character(check.multi)))==1){
        j.resp=merge(j.resp, evts, by='id_sub')
        j.resp=merge(j.resp, j.coding[,c("id_sub", "value")], by='id_sub', all.x=T)
        j.resp$type=NA
        j.resp$type=ifelse(as.numeric(j.resp$score_obs)==as.numeric(j.resp$value), 'O','G')
        j.resp=j.resp[,c('id_sub','description','text','value','type')]
        names(j.resp)=c('','Event', 'Answer', 'Score', 'Method')  
        kable.obj=kableExtra::kable((j.resp), booktabs = TRUE, caption=paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i],
                                                                             'Q', u.quest[j]  )) %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
            row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
            row_spec(1:(nrow(j.resp)-1),hline_after=T)%>%
            column_spec(1, width = "0.5cm")%>%
            column_spec(3, width = "8cm")%>%
            column_spec(2, width = "2.5cm")%>%
            column_spec(4, width = "1cm")%>%
            column_spec(5, width = "0.5cm")
        print(kable.obj)
    }else{
      multi.target=check.multi[which(check.multi==F)]
      j.coding=j.coding[!is.na(j.coding$value),]
      j.coding=j.coding[,c("id_sub", "value", names(multi.target))]
      target.col=names(multi.target)
      j.cod.s=j.coding[j.coding[,target.col]=='not_specified',]
      j.cod.m=j.coding[j.coding[,target.col]!='not_specified',]
      j.resp=merge(j.resp, evts, by='id_sub')
      j.resp=merge(j.resp, j.cod.s[,c("id_sub", "value")], by='id_sub', all.x=T)
      j.resp$type=NA
      j.resp$type=ifelse(as.numeric(j.resp$score_obs)==as.numeric(j.resp$value), 'O','G')
      j.resp$type=ifelse(j.resp$score_obs=='M','M',j.resp$type)
      j.resp=j.resp[,c('id_sub','description','text','value','type')]
      names(j.resp)=c('','Event', 'Answer', 'Score', 'Method')  
        
      kable.obj=kableExtra::kable((j.resp), booktabs = TRUE, caption=paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i],
                                                                           'Q', u.quest[j]  )) %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
            row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
            row_spec(1:(nrow(j.resp)-1),hline_after=T)%>%
            column_spec(1, width = "0.5cm")%>%
            column_spec(3, width = "8cm")%>%
            column_spec(2, width = "2.5cm")%>%
            column_spec(4, width = "1cm")%>%
            column_spec(5, width = "0.5cm")
      print(kable.obj)
      
      cat(paste('Multiple options identified', '\n\n'))
      
      j.cod.m=merge(j.cod.m, evts, by='id_sub')
      j.cod.m=j.cod.m[,c('id_sub','description',target.col ,'value')]
      names(j.cod.m)=c('','Event', as.character(target.col), 'Score (given)')   
      kable.obj.M=kableExtra::kable((j.cod.m), booktabs = TRUE, caption=paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i], 
                                                                              'Q', u.quest[j]  )) %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
            row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
            row_spec(1:(nrow(j.cod.m)-1),hline_after=T)%>%
            column_spec(1, width = "0.5cm")%>%
            column_spec(3, width = "4cm")%>%
            column_spec(2, width = "4cm")%>%
            column_spec(4, width = "0.5cm")
      print(kable.obj.M)
      
    }

        
     }
    if(nrow(j.resp)==1){
       j.resp=j.resp[,c('text','score_obs')]
       
       if(nrow(j.coding)>1){
         check.multi=apply(j.coding[,1:3], 2, function(x)unique(is.na(x)))
         j.coding=j.coding[!is.na(j.coding$value),]
         j.coding=j.coding[,c(names(multi.target), "value")]
         j.resp$value=NA
         names(j.resp)=c('Answer', 'Score (self)', 'Score (given)')
         kable.obj=kableExtra::kable((j.resp), booktabs = TRUE, caption=paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i],
                                                                              'Q', u.quest[j]  )) %>%
              kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
              row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
              column_spec(1, width = "8cm")%>%
              column_spec(2, width = "0.5cm") %>%
              column_spec(3, width = "0.5cm") 
          print(kable.obj)
          
          cat(paste('Multiple options identified', '\n\n'))
      
          names(j.coding)=c(as.character(target.col), 'Score (given)')   
      kable.obj.M=kableExtra::kable((j.coding), booktabs = TRUE, caption=paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i], 
                                                                               'Q', u.quest[j]  )) %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
            row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
            row_spec(1:(nrow(j.cod.m)-1),hline_after=T)%>%
            column_spec(1, width = "4cm")%>%
           column_spec(2, width = "0.5cm")
      print(kable.obj.M)
      next
       }
       
       if(is.na(j.coding$unit_range)){
          j.resp$value=j.coding$value
          j.resp$type=NA
          j.resp$type=ifelse(as.numeric(j.resp$score_obs)==as.numeric(j.resp$value), 'O','G')
          j.resp=j.resp[,c('text','value','type')]
          names(j.resp)=c('Answer','Score', 'Method')
          kable.obj=kableExtra::kable((j.resp), booktabs = TRUE, caption=paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i], 
                                                                               'Q', u.quest[j]  )) %>%
              kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
              row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
              column_spec(1, width = "9cm")%>%
              column_spec(2, width = "0.5cm") %>%
              column_spec(3, width = "0.5cm") 
          print(kable.obj)
       }else{
         j.resp=cbind(j.resp, j.coding[,c("range.lwr", "range.upr", "unit_range")])
         j.resp=j.resp[,c('text',"range.lwr", "range.upr", "unit_range")]
         names(j.resp)=c('Answer', 'Score - low (given)','Score - up (given)', 'Unit')
         
         kable.obj=kableExtra::kable((j.resp), booktabs = TRUE, caption=paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i],
                                                                              'Q', u.quest[j]  )) %>%
              kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
              row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
              column_spec(1, width = "8cm")%>%
              column_spec(2, width = "1cm") %>%
              column_spec(3, width = "1cm") %>%
              column_spec(4, width = "2cm") 
         print(kable.obj)
       }

     }
     if(nrow(j.resp)==3){
       j.resp$value=j.coding$value
       j.resp$type=NA
       j.resp$type=ifelse(as.numeric(j.resp$score_obs)==as.numeric(j.resp$value), 'O','G')
       j.resp=j.resp[,c('id_sub','short_description','text','value','type')]
       names(j.resp)=c('','Type','Answer', 'Score', 'Method')
       kable.obj=kableExtra::kable((j.resp), booktabs = TRUE, caption=paste('Interviewee: I', u.resp[i], 
                                                                            'Q', u.quest[j]  )) %>%
              kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
              row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
              row_spec(1:(nrow(j.resp)-1),   hline_after=T)%>%
              column_spec(3, width = "8cm")%>%
              column_spec(2, width = "3cm")%>%
              column_spec(1, width = "0.5cm")%>%
              column_spec(4, width = "0.5cm")
        print(kable.obj)
     }
     
    }
}
```
